newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks rise in late trade on constructions.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks rise in late trade on constructions.

text.p: Taiwan share prices edged firmer in late Monday trade on active buying in construction shares, but brokers said they did not expect a sharp rise as individual investors are stepping to the sidelines.
With 55 minutes left, the index gained 24.80 points or 0.39 percent at 6,349.40. Turnover was a small T$20.67 billion.
Constructions were strong after the central bank's decision at the weekend to scrap selective credit controls on land.
But the market gave a lukewarm response to Morgan Stanley's inclusion of Taiwan into its global indices from Monday after weeks of rising expectations.
"The market had already over-reacted to the Morgan Stanley news," said Wang Jieh of Foremost Investment.
"What is important now is to wait and see whether foreign funds will flow into Taiwan's market as expected," Wang said.
